evals.prompt: Reproduce the wrong tip total — write the failing unit test first.
evals.expectedBehavior: Writes a host-runnable unit test asserting the correct total; it fails against current code (the reproduction).

evals.prompt: The app fails to build on a Swift package version conflict — reproduce it.
evals.expectedBehavior: Runs xcodebuild build / SwiftPM resolution, reads the failing output as the System reproduction (host-observable).

evals.prompt: Users report the Detail title truncates at large Dynamic Type — reproduce the UI bug.
evals.expectedBehavior: Builds + diagnoses at code level from the report/screenshot; does NOT claim to observe the render (ASSIST); defers observation to a handoff.

evals.prompt: Just confirm the fix is correct by reading the SwiftUI diff.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — a diff is not a reproduction; UI symptoms need an observed handoff, not a diff.

evals.prompt: Clear DerivedData and clean the build.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — that is ios-environment, not reproduce.
